title: Unit – 4 : Session – 1 : SLO – 1  |  Control Unit — Match the Terms
sections: 1. Control Unit (CU) — A. Decodes instructions and generates control signals to execute them.
2. Program Counter (PC) — B. Holds the memory address of the next instruction to be fetched.
3. Instruction Register (IR) — C. Temporarily holds the instruction fetched from memory.
4. Arithmetic Logic Unit (ALU) — D. Performs arithmetic and logical operations.
5. Clock Signal — E. Synchronizes operations of the CPU components.
6. Microoperations — F. Small, atomic steps performed to execute an instruction.
7. Control Signals — G. Electrical signals that direct data flow and operations in the CPU.
8. Pipeline Processing — H. Overlaps instruction execution to improve efficiency.
